As member of the [[The Muunilinst 10|Muunilinst 10]], this '''ARC trooper lieutenant''' participated in the [[Battle of Hypori/Legends|Mission to Hypori]], where he was sent to rescue the surviving [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] from [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]].

==Biography==
===Early life===
Born on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] as a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], this [[Advanced Recon Commando heavy gunner|heavy Cip-Quad gunner]] was trained to become an elite [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|ARC]] [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] [[Clone Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]].<ref name="SWE" /> He was also trained to utilize the [[Reciprocating quad blaster cannon/Legends|reciprocating quad blaster]], alongside specialized [[Clone trooper armor/Legends|clone trooper armor]] to be efficient with it.<ref name="Quad Blaster">{{DB|technology|cipquad|Reciprocating Quad Blaster (Cip-Quad)}}</ref>

===Mission to Hypori===
[[File:Quad.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The ARC heavy Cip-Quad gunner, firing his [[Reciprocating quad blaster cannon/Legends|reciprocating quad blaster]] at [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]]]
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Advanced Recon Commando heavy [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]], alongside his [[Squad/Legends|squad]] leader [[Fordo|ARC-77]], and eight other ARC trooper [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenants]], were tasked with recovering a group of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] led by [[Daakman Barrek]]. Reaching [[Hypori/Legends|Hypori]] in a [[Muunilinst 10 LAAT|LAAT/i gunship]], the ARC troopers approached a downed [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ship]] in which the surviving [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] were hiding. As soon as they debarked, [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] Fordo detected three life signs and had one of his troopers check in some nearby rubble, while another checked the rafters, as the rest of the squad made their way to the life signatures. When they arrived, they were met with the sight of a wounded [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]], [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]], duelling [[Supreme Commander of the Droid Armies/Legends|General]] Grievous. The [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]] 10, along with the heavy Cip-Quad gunner, wasted no time in opening fire on the [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] [[General/Legends|general]], but Grievous was able to evade their shots. The gunner's [[Captain/Legends|captain]], reacted by having his [[Unidentified Advanced Recon Commando pilot|gunship pilot]] blast his way into the area, and open fire on the [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]]. While the cyborg fled the site, Fordo's [[Gender/Legends|men]] recovered the other surviving Jedi, [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] and [[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]].<ref name="CW">{{CW|21}}</ref> Before his unit departed from the crash site, the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone]] heavy Cip-Quad gunner was ordered to take out several [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droids]] that were threatening the surviving Jedi. Knowing that the torso was the weakest part of the super [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid's]] construction, the ARC lieutenant wasted little ammunition, and took out the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] with ease.<ref name="Grievous Hunt Hasbro">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: The Saga Collection|packtype=Battle Pack|pack=The Hunt for Grievous|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/tsc06BPhuntforgrievous.asp}}</ref>

==Equipment==
During the Battle of Hypori, this Advanced Recon Commando heavy Cip-Quad gunner wielded a high-powered rapid-firing [[Reciprocating quad blaster cannon/Legends|reciprocating quad blaster]]. The reciprocating quad [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]], often shortened to "Cip-Quad", was an experimental weapon developed during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] by [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn Munitions]]. It drew power from a [[Power cell/Legends|power cell]] strapped to a [[Soldier/Legends|soldier's]] back and was mounted on a specialized harness featuring [[Repulsorlift/Legends|microrepulsorlifts]]. The four barrels could be fired either one or two at a time depending on the rotation pattern selected, and were cooled on the recoil by coolant tanks located within the rig itself. The heavy Cip-Quad gunner was also outfitted with specialized [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I clone trooper armor]] with an experimental [[Phase II clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase II]] [[AT-RT driver|AT-RT helmet]], which included a heads-up display that was linked to the [[Cloning/Legends|clone's]] harness, allowing him to make the best use out of his weapon.<ref name="Quad Blaster" /> In addition, the trooper wore a skirt-like [[Kama/Legends|kama]], a blue [[Pauldron/Legends|pauldron]], a [[Rangefinder/Legends|rangefinder]] attached to his helmet, and specialized [[Boot/Legends|boots]] with studs on the bottom. The ARC trooper's armor had blue markings, showing that he was a lieutenant.<ref name="Hasbro" /><ref name="CW" />

==Behind the scenes==
===Character origins===
This Advanced Recon Commando heavy Cip-Quad gunner was created for the [[Chapter 21 (Star Wars: Clone Wars)|21st chapter]] of the animated television series, ''[[Star Wars: Clone Wars]]'', where he appeared alongside nine other ARC troopers in their rescue of a Jedi task force.<ref name="CW" /> [[Hasbro]] created two action figures of the clone heavy Cip-Quad gunner. One was made in [[2006]] for ''[[Star Wars: The Saga Collection]]'',<ref name="Grievous Hunt Hasbro" /> and the other in [[2008]] for ''[[Star Wars: The Legacy Collection]]''.<ref name="Hasbro" />

===Contradictions===
[[File:ARC_LAAT.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The unidentified Advanced Recon Commando heavy Cip-Quad gunner isn't shown with the rest of his squad.]]
In Chapter 21 of ''[[Star Wars]]: Clone Wars'', we see the Muunilinst 10 arrive at the location of the crashed ''Acclamator'' on Hypori. While all of the members of the unit are shown aboard their [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i gunship]], the heavy Cip-Quad gunner only appears at the end of the unloading sequence. The ARC heavy Cip-Quad gunner would disappear right after, and appear again in the fight against General Grievous. After that engagement, the gunner disappeared once more, and was never shown again in the episode.<ref name="CW" />

While the ARC lieutenant is shown carrying a reciprocating quad blaster in the show, all other artwork and toys of the trooper depict him with a [[Z-6 rotary blaster cannon]].<ref name="Grievous Hunt Hasbro" /><ref name="Hasbro" />
